notes: MERIDIAN v2 OUTSIDE LOFT (No.10, side, facing east; right-footed: the near/right leg kicks with the OUTSIDE of the boot, ankle turned IN, sole tipped to the camera; the far/left leg plants). Not mirrored (no west strip). Registration = the Trivela canvas (= GALE Strike canvas): world origin originDx +56 from the AP1/Run canvas. contact = the plant (far/left) toe column (76,102) on all six frames (flat LF1-LF2, rolling onto the toe LF3, up on the toe LF4/LF4b; the same pixel as Trivela T5/T8a/T8b). ball = the 12 px ball guide (90,96) on LF1-LF2 (never drawn). boot = the outside-of-the-boot point: LF2 (85,99) = the little-toe face on the ball rim at contact (the game places the ball touching it), LF3 (100,58) the smear's leading edge, LF4/LF4b (94,42) the raised boot at shoulder height (sole to the camera); outside = the same outside-face point (LF1s (48,94): low behind the plant in the swing); toe_n = the kicking toe tip (LF4/LF4b); knee_n = the near knee at contact (LF2); fist = the far fist raised above the crown (LF4/LF4b); head = skull centre (head AWAY on every frame: mop and ear, no eye); sleeve10 = the near sleeve "10" glyph origin. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] measured on the art. Shot 3 (shot-local, on-screen): AP1 0.00, AP3 0.10 (Approach strip), LF1 0.22-0.46 (x2.4, rate 0.3 = the breath), LF1s 0.46-0.50 (replaces Trivela T5), LF2 0.50-0.66 (the hit-stop 0.03), LF3 0.66-0.72, LF4 0.72, LF4b/LF4 every 0.2 s (LF4 1.12), LF4b 1.32-1.58, then Trivela T8a 1.58-1.62 (bridge) and T8b 1.62. LF4b -> T8a seam: the 1.45-1.59 crash punch-in zoomAbout target = the CURRENT frame's head + originDx (LF4/LF4b (49,21) -> T8a (72,17) -> T8b (71,17)), eased LF4b -> T8a over 1.50-1.58 (outCubic) so the head stays centred. Shot 4: LF4 as a 0.4x boxed cache (wide). Studio layer: Art only (numbers in Art; no Num/Ball layer). The ball is never drawn in a frame: the game draws it at ball/boot/forehead. Studio: Sochetra / Loft / Side (Front/Back views blank).
